decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed erection of a single storey side and rear extension, by reason of positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, are considered to be acceptable having due regard for the existing building, the site characteristics, the street scene and the immediate local area.  The proposal would not be harmful to the character and appearance of the house, the street scene or local area; neither would it have an undue effect on and be harmful to the amenities of any neighbouring properties.  The development is considered to be in accordance with the relevant provisions of adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), and ENV-H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions), of the adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003), and the Supplementary Planning Guidance (Residential Extension Guidelines).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.

Condition : 6 - The high level window in the south-western facing side elevation of the extension shall only be provided in obscure glass, details of which shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.  In addition, the window shall be fixed, i.e. non-openable. The window shall be provided in accordance with the details as approved and shall be retained as such.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details of the roof of the extension shown on the submitted plans, details of consistent elevational plans in respect of the roof treatment shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.  The approved details shall be implemented only as approved.

Condition : 8 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - The applicant is advised to contact the Principle Building Surveyor (Mr Paul Knight ) on Tel. 020 8583 5407 prior to the commencement of any work on the extension to clarify measures which may have to be taken in respect of existing Main Drainage.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension to house following removal of existing detached side garage and rear porch.
